title: Microsoft Graph Delta Round Traversal Closure
supportedOperation: A nonempty ordered bundle beginning at the exact root URL, following every @odata.nextLink byte-for-byte, and ending at @odata.deltaLink.
negativeProposition: The exact delta round emitted zero resources or change events across the entire validated traversal.
notes: A final empty deltaLink page alone is never sufficient because earlier pages may contain resources.
A deltaLink closes one round; it does not establish eternal absence or source truth.
